answer: Latency trellis: new identities route through a decaying delay ladder, each first message waiting longer than the last the network has seen from that agent. A quill signing burst pays escalating wall-clock cost per message until history accrues. Cheap for a sparrow-sized honest user, ruinous for a farm: synchronizing thousands of fresh keys multiplies total wait time, so mass sybil creation costs attacker-days of throughput, not fees.
